# African Savanna Elephant

 Loxodonta africana 

 ⚠ This is not the latest assessment for this species. See the latest assessments: 

 Global 

Abstract

 African Savanna Elephant Loxodonta africana has most recently been assessed for The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species in 2020. Loxodonta africana is listed as Endangered under criteria A2abd.
